changeVesselOwner.paragraph1.comment: Regulatory text about notifying a change in vessel ownership. Legal text: needs a professional translator.
changeVesselOwner.paragraph1.en: Any change in vessel ownership must be notified immediately to the Registry of Shipping and Seamen and the MMO office where the fishing vessel licence was issued. When a change in ownership occurs, the licence attached to the vessel must be turned into an entitlement, and the licence transferred to the new owners.

changeVesselOwner.paragraph2.comment: Regulatory text about licence validity. Legal text: needs a professional translator.
changeVesselOwner.paragraph2.en: A fishing vessel licence is invalid if there are any changes to sections 1-5 of the licence. In the event of any such changes, you should contact your local MMO office. Fishing with an invalid licence is a criminal offence and could lead to enforcement action being taken against you.
